#InCaseYouMissedIt │Protesters raise placards and fists during a nationwide rally on September 21, 2025, denouncing alleged corruption in flood control projects and demanding accountability from government officials.

Former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) undersecretary for operations Roberto Bernardo dropped more high-profile figures as the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee’s legislative inquiry into questionable flood control corruption continued on Thursday.

Bernardo revealed that the extent of corruption involved former Senate President Francis ‘Chiz’ Escudero.

However, Escudero on Thursday rejected Bernardo's allegations.

📸: Edd Castro

For more info, visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSOvI

data.text:
LOOK: The United Filipino Consumers and Commuters (UFCC) stages a protest in front of the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) in Makati City at 10 a.m. on Tuesday, September 30.

The group demands the removal of the ₱16 increase in cement prices, which they say is an unfair burden on ordinary Filipinos. UFCC members argue that the price hike worsens the cost-of-living crisis and negatively affects housing and construction. They urge the DTI to take immediate action to protect consumers and ensure fair market practices. 

📷: Mark Balmores | MB
